candidates.title: Overlapping Reference Grammar and Manual Grammar Systems
candidates.description: Two parallel grammar systems exist across all 13 languages: step-by-step communicative manual pages in manuals/{lang}/grammar/ and exhaustive reference grammar pages in reference-grammar/{lang}/. This creates double-maintenance overhead and duplicate topic definitions.
candidates.recommendation: Consolidate reference-grammar/ into manuals/{lang}/grammar/ as reference tabs or extract reference-grammar to an appendix section in COSYtools/COSYmanuals.

candidates.title: Duplicate Navigation Bar JS File
candidates.description: The top navigation bar implementation exists in both js/core/engine.js and shared/js/core/engine.js with minor divergence in link mappings.
candidates.recommendation: Remove js/core/engine.js and standardize on shared/js/core/engine.js across all pages.

candidates.title: Misplaced Print Studio Sub-Application (COSYstudio Candidate)
candidates.description: Print studio builders and physical resource generators are scattered across root directory (print-*.html) and apps/print-studio/, violating repository isolation principles.
candidates.recommendation: Consolidate all print tools into a dedicated repository COSYstudio or move under apps/print-studio/ inside COSYtools.

candidates.title: Misplaced Premium Course Application (COSYcourses Candidate)
candidates.description: Syllabus-driven course paths reside inside apps/premium-courses/ on COSYlanguages while curriculum materials are in COSYmanuals/curriculum/.
candidates.recommendation: Extract apps/premium-courses/ into a dedicated repository COSYcourses as defined in docs/ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md.

candidates.title: Insecure Hardcoded Role Access Dataset
candidates.description: Hardcoded access codes for admin, teacher, and student roles stored in plain text inside a publicly served static JSON file.
candidates.recommendation: Remove data/access/codes.json from public version control immediately and replace with serverless token verification or client-side COSY Passport cryptographic session verification.
